title: Step sequencer
description: Sixteen physical keys hold a pattern beneath a synchronized glass step display.
useCase: Author and inspect a short step pattern with separate enabled and current-step feedback.
interaction: Toggle keys and start or pause playback; reduced-motion playback advances one step at a time.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion uses a static playhead with an explicit Next step action.
limitations: Visual sequence only; no audio playback or synthesis.
look: Skeuomorphic graphite hardware panel on warm grey with a dark glass display, pale play key, and rows of charcoal and cream keys with amber lights.
motion: Pressing a key latches it 1 px down and lights its amber strip; playback advances a glowing step marker across the sixteen keys and display every 250 ms, looping.
adapt: Steps live in `steps` (from `initialPattern`) and `beat` advances in a 250 ms `setInterval`; key depth and lights are CSS on `sf-stepbank-face` and `sf-stepbank-light` via `aria-pressed` and `data-current`. Drive audio from `beat` and retune 250 for tempo.
